test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under which articles of the Constitution of India is the Right to Equality mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 14-18.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The** Right to Equality** is one of the **six fundamental rights** of the Constitution.&
